summary: Winston County, MS tower on the edge of Tombigbee National Forest; the Register lists a 100 ft Aermotor LS-40 registered in 2023 as US 1744, with no build date or history found.

facts.status_note: Register describes the tower at its July 2023 site visit; no statement of current condition

access.note: Register says the Mississippi Forestry Commission has active offices at the site and describes no public access; ask the agency before visiting

events.note: Registered July 9, 2023 as US 1744, MS 61 after a July 8, 2023 site visit

evidence.supports: tower on the edge of the Tombigbee National Forest in Winston County
evidence.quote: This tower is located on the edge of the Tombigbee National Forest.
The tower is a 100ft Aermotor LS-40.

evidence.supports: administered by the Mississippi Forestry Commission
Forestry Commission has active offices at the site
evidence.quote: The MFC has active offices at this location.

notes_for_editor: Single source (NHLR). Two searches turned up no build date, builder, staffing or condition history. Map sites list a 'Winston Lookout Tower' and a 'Tombigbee Lookout Tower' in Winston County; those were search snippets only, not fetched, and nothing says whether either is this tower, so neither is used. Access level 'restricted' is inferred from the active MFC offices on the site, not from an access statement. The register's Louisville name is the only one confirmed.
